text: Amnesty International and Human Rights Watch report that migrant workers in Qatar still faced labour abuses and exploitation under the kafala sponsorship system in 2025, despite reforms.

source.name: Amnesty International: Qatar 2025 (annual report country entry)
source.quote: Despite recent legal reforms, migrant workers continued to face labour abuses, including an exploitative kafala sponsorship system

additionalSources.name: Human Rights Watch: World Report 2026, Qatar
additionalSources.quote: Migrant workers comprise over 91 percent of Qatar’s population and continue to face widespread abuse under the country’s restrictive kafala (labor sponsorship) system.
